scope: Render-only POSITIVE physical fracture evidence on the synthetic row-8 bridge specimen. V4 produced a real false STOP at structural 8 mm in the same legal camera pose used for its 9 mm positive; a missing intact ink tile and three apparent deep pixels are not evidence of rupture. V4 evidence remains a failed development result. No control integration or acceptance.
render_rule: Keep all v4 intact ligament faces and untouched physical springs/nodes/constraint-based independent score. When and only when the three EXISTING bonds of a row-8 cell have all physically severed, render the two exposed material flanks of that specific cell as separate left/right blue-green fracture faces, each anchored to the original four physical PBD nodes, with a visible gap between them. The renderer never calls cut_length, computes a prefix or changes bond liveness, jaw motion, collision or force; these are material surfaces created by physical fracture, not a numeric stop label.
pixel_preflight: At 70-degree HD, 1280x960, 135 mm working range and 0.45 obliquity, a 0.35 x 0.64 mm fracture face should project to roughly 4.6 pixels. Use a same-frame minimum of 3 color-connected pixels on EACH of the two newly exposed flanks and at least 2 depth-through pixels between them. If either is occluded, output UNKNOWN. In particular the historical actual-8 false STOP frame must now be UNKNOWN or NOT_STOP, never STOP.
image_gate: Seal RGB-D-only predictions before consulting the independent original 9-10 mm structural scorer. Require zero STOP at every <9 mm observation including the v4 same-pose 8 mm counterexample, at least two direct, scissors-visible STOPs at actual 9 mm from a full uncut nominal run and two qualified NOT_STOPs at actual 8 mm from the 0.5 mm noisy full run. Missing or occluded material remains UNKNOWN and fails this gate. No stop-only FSM certificate is allowed until this and independent confirmation pass.
next: If image gate passes, version the stop-only FSM integration without authorizing movement or closure from an endpoint marker; then run all five scenarios from zero with strict truth isolation and closed measured ready-pose verification.
